items.title: Биом: лес
items.summary: Лес густо покрыт дубами и берёзами — удобное место за брёвнами. По данным вики, это самый распространённый наземный биом Верхнего мира, около 12% его площади.

items.title: Биом: пустыня
items.summary: Пустыня — обширный засушливый биом в основном из песка; в ней встречаются пустынные пирамиды и деревни, а также опасные разновидности враждебных мобов.

items.title: Биом: равнины
items.summary: Равнины — распространённые травянистые биомы Верхнего мира с открытым рельефом и цветами.

items.title: Биом: тайга
items.summary: Тайга — влажный и холодный биом с папоротниками, елями и соснами; здесь часто появляются лисы и волки.

items.title: Бревно: первый ресурс
items.summary: Бревно добывают из деревьев; из него делают доски — с этого начинается почти вся ранняя цепочка крафта.

items.title: Булыжник
items.summary: Булыжник получают, добывая камень; он идёт в крафт и на строительство.

items.title: Доски: из чего и сколько
items.summary: Доски — основа ранних рецептов. По сетке источника из одного бревна или ствола получается 4 доски, из блока бамбука — 2.

items.title: Дверь: преграда, которую можно открыть
items.summary: Дверь — переключаемая преграда для существ. Ставится только на полный твёрдый блок снизу и занимает два блока в высоту.

items.title: Факел: уголь и палка
items.summary: Факел ломается мгновенно чем угодно. По сетке источника уголь или древесный уголь и палка дают 4 факела.

items.title: Кирка: инструмент для камня и руды
items.summary: Кирка нужна, чтобы добывать большинство каменных блоков и руд; её уровень определяет, какие блоки она соберёт. По данным вики, кирки любого уровня делают из двух палок и трёх единиц материала своего уровня — в сетке источника это 5 занятых клеток и 1 кирка.

items.title: Кровать: ночь и точка возрождения
items.summary: Кровать позволяет в Верхнем мире переспать ночь и переносит точку возрождения к кровати, пока её не сломали и не загородили. По сетке источника шерсть одного цвета и доски дают 1 кровать.

items.title: Лестница: 7 палок — 3 лестницы
items.summary: Лестница позволяет подниматься по вертикали; ставится только на боковые стороны блоков. Из 7 палок получается 3 лестницы.

items.title: Лопата: песок, гравий и земля
items.summary: Лопата быстро копает песок, гравий и землю. В сетке источника рецепт занимает 3 клетки — материал своего уровня и палки — и даёт 1 лопату.

items.title: Меч: оружие ближнего боя
items.summary: Меч — оружие ближнего боя; он быстрее ломает паутину, листья и бамбук. По данным вики, все мечи, кроме незеритового, делают из палки и двух единиц материала — 3 занятые клетки и 1 меч.

items.title: Палка: 2 доски — 4 палки
items.summary: Палка нужна для инструментов, факелов и лестниц. По сетке источника из двух досок получается 4 палки; есть и рецепт из бамбука.

items.title: Печь: переплавка и готовка
items.summary: Печь работает двумя способами: переплавляет руду и готовит еду, если положить внутрь топливо и подходящий предмет. Делается из 8 блоков каменного уровня.

items.title: Щит: защита от атак
items.summary: Щит блокирует урон от ближних и дальних атак и взрывов; удар топором временно отключает его. Делается из досок и железного слитка.

items.title: Ступеньки: 6 блоков — 4 ступеньки
items.summary: Ступеньки позволяют подниматься на блок без прыжка. Все ступеньки крафтятся одинаково: из 6 блоков получается 4 ступеньки того же вида.

items.title: Сундук: хранилище базы
items.summary: Сундук делается из 8 досок любого вида; два соседних сундука образуют большой сундук, который вмещает вдвое больше.

items.title: Сырое железо
items.summary: Сырое железо добывают из железной руды и переплавляют в печи или плавильне в железные слитки.

items.title: Топор: дерево и растения
items.summary: Топор быстро рубит древесину и растения; как оружие он бьёт сильно, но медленно. По данным вики, топоры любого уровня делают из 2 палок и 3 единиц материала своего уровня — в сетке источника 5 занятых клеток и 1 топор.

items.title: Уголь
items.summary: Уголь добывают в основном из угольной руды; он нужен для факелов и костров, а также служит топливом.

items.title: Ведро: вода, лава, молоко
items.summary: Ведро переносит воду, лаву, молоко и другие вещества. Делается из 3 железных слитков.

items.title: Версия игры: Java Edition 26.3
items.summary: Главная страница вики на день чтения называет текущей версию Java Edition 26.3. Рецепты сверены со страницами вики, прочитанными в тот же день.

items.title: Верстак: доступ ко всем рецептам
items.summary: Верстак открывает все рецепты крафта, включая те, что недоступны в сетке инвентаря. Делается из 4 досок любого вида.

items.title: Забор: 6 слотов — 3 забора
items.summary: Забор — барьер, через который обычно не перепрыгнуть; игрок, в отличие от мобов, видит сквозь просветы. Высота столкновения — 1,5 блока. По сетке источника доски и палки в 6 слотах дают 3 забора.

items.title: Железный слиток
items.summary: Слиток выплавляют из сырого железа; из него делают многие предметы и инструменты. Блок железа разбирается на 9 слитков, а 9 самородков собираются в слиток.

src-1c1de0a8fd.name: Chest
lead: A large chest (or "double chest") is the combination of two adjacent chests, and can store twice as many items.

A chest can be broken using anything, but an axe is the fastest. Chests always drop themselves when mined. If the chest contains items, the items are also dropped when the chest is broken. If one half of a large chest is destroyed, the corresponding items from the destroyed chest (in Java Edition , the top three rows for the left-hand chest or the bottom three for the chest on the right; in Bedrock Edition , the top three for whichever half was placed first or the bottom three for whichever half was placed last) are dropped and the remaining half continues to function as a small chest.

src-2d59dbaf94.name: Minecraft Wiki
lead: Welcome to the most comprehensive wiki about the Minecraft franchise , proudly community-run since 2009. Anyone can contribute!

Minecraft is a 3D sandbox adventure game developed by Mojang Studios , where players can interact with a fully customizable three-dimensional world made of blocks and entities . Its diverse gameplay options allow players to choose the way they play, creating infinite possibilities.

src-336bf32f13.name: Shovel
lead: A shovel is a tiered tool that can quickly break sand , gravel , and dirt -related blocks. Shovels also have a unique use interaction with dirt-related blocks and snow layers ‌ [ Bedrock Edition only ] and can turn them into dirt paths or snowballs respectively.
In ancient_city/city_center/city_center_2 , there exists a furnace with a wooden shovel inside.

recipes.ingredients: Any Planks or Gold Ingot or Any stone-tier block or Copper Ingot or Iron Ingot or Diamond + Stick

src-3ca8a7f9ee.name: Axe
lead: An axe is a tiered tool that can quickly break wood and plant blocks, and a melee weapon with high attack damage but low attack speed .‌ [ JE only ] It has the special ability to perform crushing blows , which disable the use of a target's shield.
Wooden, golden, stone, copper, iron, and diamond axes are crafted using 2 sticks and 3 identical units of tool material. This recipe can be flipped horizontally.

recipes.ingredients: Any Planks or Gold Ingot or Any stone-tier block or Copper Ingot or Iron Ingot or Diamond + Stick

src-429987c579.name: Door
lead: A door is a block that serves as a switchable barrier to entity movement.

Doors must be supported by a full solid block face beneath them. The bottom half of the door is placed where the player is aiming, with the top half extending one block above. If there is not enough space for the door, or not an appropriate supporting block underneath the base, no action is performed.

src-553de39ee4.name: Bucket
lead: A bucket is a utility item used to carry water , lava , milk , powder snow , and sulfur cubes .

Using a water , lava , or powder snow bucket empties the bucket, resulting in a regular empty bucket. Emptying a bucket of sulfur cube also returns an empty bucket, but other buckets of mob do not, giving a water bucket instead.

src-73a470da69.name: Crafting Table
lead: A crafting table is a utility block that gives access to all crafting recipes, including many not available from the inventory 's crafting grid.
Crafting tables can be mined by hand or with any tool, but axes are the quickest.

src-7a7d1e03f6.name: Planks
lead: Planks are common blocks used as building blocks and in crafting recipes. They are usually one of the first things that a player crafts in Survival mode. There are currently 13 variants of planks, which can be differentiated into three categories: Overworld planks made from tree logs, bamboo planks made from blocks of bamboo , and nonflammable Nether planks made from huge fungus stems.
Planks can be broken by hand, but using an axe speeds up the process.

recipes.ingredients: Matching Log or Matching Stem or Matching Stripped Log or Matching Stripped Stem or Matching Wood or Matching Hyphae or Matching Stripped Wood or Matching Stripped Hyphae
Block of Bamboo or Block of Stripped Bamboo

src-7b76afa6f7.name: Pickaxe
lead: A pickaxe is a tiered tool that is required to mine most types of stone , ores , and blocks crafted from stone or ores. The mining level of a given pickaxe determines which blocks it can collect.
Wooden, golden, stone, copper, iron, and diamond pickaxes are crafted using two sticks and three of the tier’s material.

recipes.ingredients: Any Planks or Gold Ingot or Any stone-tier block or Copper Ingot or Iron Ingot or Diamond + Stick

src-8157fe9f03.name: Furnace
lead: A furnace is a block with two functions: it can be used for either smelting or cooking , by placing fuel and an appropriate item inside together.
A furnace can be picked up using any pickaxe . If mined without a pickaxe, it does not drop itself.

src-82215d6f2e.name: Taiga
lead: The taiga is a humid and cold biome comprising a grassland forested with small and large ferns, pale aquamarine-green grass, spruce and pine trees. Foxes and wolves commonly spawn here.

Taigas generate in the moderately high humidity zones of cold temperature areas, as well as the highest humidity zones of frozen areas. They commonly border old growth taigas , forests , and snowy taigas , and less frequently birch forests . In cold temperature areas, they can generate in any type of terrain; flatlands near shattered windswept forests and swamps , rolling slopes and plateaus, or mountains with groves on the slopes.

src-8fa4938b74.name: Log
lead: A log or stem is a naturally occurring block found in trees or huge fungi , primarily used as a building block and to create planks , a versatile crafting ingredient. There are currently ten types of logs: oak , spruce , birch , jungle , acacia , dark oak , mangrove , cherry , pale oak and poplar ; and two types of stems: crimson and warped .
Logs and stems can be broken by hand, but using an axe is faster. Logs and stems drop themselves when broken with any tool.

src-930ee91150.name: Shield
lead: A shield is a defensive tool that can be used to block damage from melee attacks, ranged attacks and explosions. Shields are temporarily disabled when hit by an axe or attacked by a warden using its melee attack while blocking, and certain damage sources ignore a shield's protection. Shields can have ornamental banner designs applied to them.

Shields are used for blocking incoming attacks. Using ‌ [ JE only ] or sneaking ‌ [ BE only ] causes a player to slow to a sneaking pace, and after 5 game ticks (0.25 seconds) , non-piercing attacks coming from in front of the player are blocked, dealing no damage. Shields deal knockback when blocking melee attacks‌ [ BE only ] , unless the entity is immune to knockback. When the shield blocks an attack of 3 HP or stronger, it takes durability damage equal to the strength of the attack rounded up. When a player enters a boat, their shields exhibit the blocking animation. In Bedrock Edition , a shield cannot be activated for ? ticks [ check the code ] after attacking. In Java Edition , attacking while shielding does not perform an attack, while in Bedrock Edition attacks can be performed but lower the shield when doing so.

recipes.ingredients: Matching Wool + Any Planks + Iron Ingot

src-9579a8cc05.name: Forest
lead: The forest is a lush biome densely covered with oak and birch trees. Woods wolves spawn here. The forest is the most common Overworld surface biome in Minecraft , making up about 12% of its area.
Forests generate in a broad range of moderate temperatures, with a somewhat more restrictive medium humidity requirement.

src-985aec5fcb.name: Desert
lead: A desert is an expansive arid biome mainly consisting of sand . It is notable for its many structures such as desert pyramids and villages , and its dangerous hostile mob variants.
Deserts generate in areas with very high temperatures. Despite being uncommon, deserts make up around 2.4% of the Overworld by area since they tend to be quite large.

src-9cea39e37a.name: Stick
lead: All leaf types have a 2% chance to drop 1–2 sticks when they decay or when broken using a tool without Silk Touch . Using a tool with Fortune increases these chances to 2.2%, 2.5%, and 3.3% for Fortune I, II, and III respectively.
Issues relating to "Stick" are maintained on the bug tracker . Issues should be reported and viewed there .

src-a9ad1e6170.name: Ladder
lead: The ladder is a block used for climbing vertically or horizontally. They can be placed only on the sides of other blocks.

Ladders generate naturally in library rooms of strongholds and in intersection rooms with a wooden ceiling. Ladders can also be found in village structures such as plains and taiga temples and many small or medium houses, as well as in churches. They may also be found leading to the basements of igloos , in end ships on the pillar leading up to the crow's nest, and in rail rooms of woodland mansions . Ladders can also generate in ancient cities , trail ruins , trial chambers , and in end cities .

src-ad3fa70d4d.name: Fence
lead: A fence is a barrier block that cannot normally be jumped over, similar to a wall . Unlike a wall, a player (but not mobs ) can see through the openings in a fence.

While fences appear to be a single block tall and have a hitbox height of one block, their collision box (for entities) is 1.5 blocks tall , meaning most mobs cannot jump over them without the Jump Boost status effect. They are transparent to light and have visual gaps in the model. Spiders can climb over a fence, just like any other vertical object. Camels can walk over fences.

src-b11ea9dd8d.name: Plains
lead: The plains are common grassland biomes in the Overworld with wide, open terrain and flowers .

Plains are the second-most common Overworld biome after forests , covering about 10.2% of its area. This is due to both their abundance and their potential to grow very large. They generate across a broad range of moderate temperatures when humidity is low to moderate.

src-b827b5ae81.name: Bed
lead: A bed is a dyeable utility block that allows a player in the Overworld to sleep through the night and change their spawn point to within a few blocks of the bed, as long as it is not broken or obstructed. Villagers sleep in beds at night and require spare beds to produce offspring .
Beds are used by pressing the use item button while looking at the bed.

recipes.ingredients: Any Bed + Bone Meal or Lapis Lazuli or Cocoa Beans or Ink Sac

src-c7c5312bdc.name: Stairs
lead: Stairs are blocks that allow mobs and players to change elevation without jumping.
All stairs have the same crafting recipe format, where six blocks result in four stairs of the same type. Like axes , the crafting recipe of stairs can be horizontally flipped.

recipes.ingredients: Planks , Bamboo Mosaic , stone blocks, brick blocks, Quartz Block , Smooth Quartz , Cut Copper , Wool , or Concrete

src-ccd9178392.name: Cobblestone
lead: Cobblestone is a common block obtained from mining stone . It is mainly used for crafting or as a building block.
The suitable tool to break cobblestone is pickaxe . Cobblestone needs to be broken using a pickaxe, otherwise the breaking time will increase and the block drops nothing.

src-d304033453.name: Coal
lead: Coal is a mineral item mainly obtained from coal ore . It is primarily used for crafting torches and campfires , in addition to being used as fuel .
Coal ore when mined using a pickaxe drops 1 piece of coal. If the pickaxe is enchanted with Fortune , it may drop an extra piece per level of Fortune, up to a maximum of 4 with Fortune III.

src-d4b63de502.name: Torch
lead: Torches can be broken instantly using anything, and drop themselves as an item.
When lava flows into a torch's space, it will be destroyed without dropping anything.

recipes.ingredients: Cerium Chloride or Mercuric Chloride or Potassium Chloride or Tungsten Chloride + Torch

src-d50a9910ee.name: Raw Iron
lead: Raw iron is an item obtained by mining iron ore . It can be smelted in a furnace or blast furnace to produce iron ingots , which are used in crafting.

Iron ore and deepslate iron ore mined with a stone pickaxe or a higher-tier pickaxe drop 1 unit of raw iron. When mined with a pickaxe enchanted with Fortune , the ore can drop an additional unit per level of the enchantment, up to a maximum of 4 units with Fortune III. If mined with a pickaxe enchanted with Silk Touch , the ore block itself is dropped instead.

src-dddfa2fa81.name: Sword
lead: A sword is a tiered melee weapon that can be swung to deal damage and can break blocks such as cobwebs , leaves , and bamboo more quickly. In Java Edition , it has the special ability to perform sweep attacks , which damage nearby entities and knock them back.
All swords except netherite are crafted using a stick and two of the tier's material.

recipes.ingredients: Any Planks or Gold Ingot or Any stone-tier block or Copper Ingot or Iron Ingot or Diamond + Stick

src-f04b885346.name: Iron Ingot
lead: An iron ingot is a metal ingot smelted from raw iron that is used to craft many items and tools .
Smelting raw iron in a furnace or blast furnace is the most common way to obtain iron ingots.
